method: Whole-file manual reading of seven COM/input/geometry/hook declaration files; exact-commit downloads matched pinned Git blob IDs.
findings: IServiceProvider.QueryService and IShellBrowser.GetWindow preserve HRESULT int returns; success must be checked by callers. Out interface/handle declarations alone provide no ownership or lifetime validation.
IShellBrowser is a minimal interface declaration exposing inherited GetWindow slot only. No full shell browsing or content comparison implementation present.

IAccessible exposes dispatch IDs, BStr strings, variant object children/roles and locations. Returned objects/strings require caller handling; accessibility role is not filesystem type or file identity.

INPUT is sequential tag plus explicit union at offset0, with native-width extra-info fields. KEYBDINPUT depends on VirtualKey underlying type, not inspected in this increment; no ABI size/alignment qualification claimed.

RECT has four signed32-bit coordinates and no geometry arithmetic or bounds checks. WinEventDelegate carries hook/window handles and32-bit event/thread/time fields; no lifecycle guarantees in declaration.
IHook only promises StartHook/StopHook/Dispose and IsHookActive. Idempotence, callback drainage, synchronization and failure reporting remain implementation questions.
limits: No WinAPI invocation, ABI layout test, COM ownership/reentrancy test or original build. No foreign production code adopted.
